drain_6h.instructions: Within the next 6 hours, will this token be drained: its pool liquidity pulled, or its price collapsing below a fifth of the current price?

criteria.true: drained within 6 hours (rug pull or collapse)
criteria.false: liquidity and price hold above those floors for 6 hours

outcome_6h.instructions: Which outcome is most likely for this token over the next 6 hours?

criteria.RUG: drained (liquidity pulled or price below a fifth) without first doubling
criteria.WIN: price reaches at least 3x the current price while the pool still holds at least $10k of liquidity
criteria.DUD: neither: it drifts, fades or stalls
